The largest medical and pharmaceutical distributor in the United States and globally is **McKesson Corporation**, closely followed by massive industry leaders like **Cencora** (formerly AmerisourceBergen) and **Cardinal Health**. [](https://finance.yahoo.com/research-hub/screener/sec-ind_ind-largest-equities_medical-distribution/)

- **[McKesson Corporation](https://www.mckesson.com/medical-supplies/)**: The largest broad-line healthcare services and medical-surgical supply distributor, serving a vast network of hospitals, pharmacies, and care facilities. [](https://www.mckesson.com/medical-supplies/)

- **Cencora**: A massive global healthcare solutions and pharmaceutical distributor handling a huge percentage of the world's clinical supply chain.

- **Cardinal Health**: A major global manufacturer and distributor providing lab supplies, surgical products, and pharmaceuticals to health systems worldwide.

- **Medline Industries**

: A massive private manufacturer and distributor specializing directly in medical-surgical products.
